I wasn't sure where else to post this. I don't really want any responses. I just need to get my feelings out to help with my coping.

I was at a rehearsal for an Operetta I'll be performing in a few weeks and I got a call from my oldest sister. There was a chain of phone calls letting us know my cousin had been found dead in an abandoned building. They think he has been dead for about a week from drug overdose.

He was my youngest cousin growing up, two years older than me, so we spent all of our time together during the years when we lived in the same town. When my youngest sister died 9 years ago he was one of the first people I went to after hearing the news. I haven't had the chance to talk to him for a few years because he moved about six states away and didn't stay in constant contact with the family. I wasn't even able to find him to invite him to my wedding which was a year ago this past Sunday. I don't know if he even could have made it if I had contacted him because he was usually on probation.

To make things worse, tomorrow is my wife's birthday. I had planned on doing something for her but now I don't know if I'll be able to.

Like I said I just wanted to get my thoughts out. I feel like once I start saying anything about it, even to strangers on the internet, it will help me start talking to the people in my life to vent more. I mostly wanted to do it on here because It's been an hour since I found out so I still can't quite form words.
